title: SkillPoints
description: A datapack that adds use to default minecraft advancements by giving points to upgrade yourself.
body:
This pack adds a new item, the skilltree key.

This item can be found in some overworld structures: pillager towers, desert temples, jungle temples, mineshafts, dungeons and shipwrecks.
(The spawn chance is not that high, so you'll have to search 2 to 5 structures on average.)
Use this item on a barrel, and it changes into a skilltree table. In here, you can spend skillpoints(sp) that you have acquired trough completing vanilla advancements for player upgrades.

The upgrades are categorized into 3 categories.
Player upgrades:
Saturation Skill (5sp)
Speed Skill (5sp)
Item Magnet Skill (10sp) (u can use trigger magnet to disable)
Conduit Skill (10sp)
Mining Skills:
Veinmine Skill (40sp) (use trigger veinmine to enable and disable)
Autosmelt Skill (20sp)
Fighting Skills
Quick Attack Skill (20sp)

Almost all advancements give 1 sp, some advancements give 5, some give 10, and some give 20.

Note: The resourcepack is HIGHLY recommended!!! The pack works without it, but is bad without it.
